Application Data.NAME: Healthy Supplies, Inc.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Healthy Supplies, Inc. operates as a medical and hospital supply store, providing a wide range of high-quality medical supplies, equipment, and related products to healthcare facilities and individual customers. Our operations focus on ensuring compliance with health regulations, maintaining a clean and safe retail environment, and delivering exceptional customer service. We prioritize quality assurance and source products from reputable manufacturers. Additionally, we have implemented rigorous inventory management and loss control measures to minimize risks associated with product liability and operational hazards. Our team is trained in compliance with health and safety standards, ensuring a reliable shopping experience for our clients.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 03/15/2023, a slip and fall incident occurred in the store, resulting in an injured customer. The total medical expenses for the claim amounted to $2,500.00. The claim is currently open, under review, and we are cooperating with the insurance adjuster to resolve the matter swiftly.
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Surveillance cameras and alarm systems monitored 24/7, along with limited access control for sensitive areas within the store.
